text:
adi: Idea: small "migration sherpa" service to run tenant-scoped API shims for field renames and light shape changes. Opt-in, auto-expire, emit telemetry. Thoughts?

sylvie: Sounds useful. Main risk = becoming permanent technical debt. Need hard expiry and migration nudges.

matt: Telemetry must include rewrite counts, error rate, and sample redacted payloads. Console should surface migration health.

laura: Ops: two execution modes — inline cheap transforms vs async worker for expensive conversions. Also add cost meter for billing.

kevin: Reuse proxy transform hooks. Need header negotiation for sherpa capabilities e.g. `Accept-Compat: sherpa=v1`.

ops-bot: Heads up: canary slot open tomorrow 03:00 UTC in `canary/sherpa-2026-03`.

adi: Action: I'll draft RFC. Owners: sylvie/matt telemetry, laura ops/billing, kevin header proto. Will post by EOD Friday.
